PEANUT FREE: These chewy granola bars are peanut free and made in a peanut free facility; Not all Nature Valley products are made in peanut-free facilities; Visit our website to learn more about this product

S'MORES: Kids will love the irresistible taste of whole grain oats, milk chocolate, white chocolate chunks, and graham

WHOLESOME SNACKS: Parents can feel good about serving a wholesome snack

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 9g whole grain (At least 48g recommend daily) and is made with no artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 4.6 oz box of Nature Valley S'mores Lunch Box Chewy Granola Bars
features:
Key Features:

S’mores Flavor

Delicious chewy granola bars made with chocolate chips, graham pieces, and white chocolate chunks—captures the classic campfire s’mores taste.

Peanut-Free

Produced in a peanut-free facility, making them a safe option for kids with nut allergies and perfect for school snacks.

Whole Grains & Fiber

Each bar contains 9g of whole grains and 5g of dietary fiber to support digestion and provide lasting energy.

No Artificial Additives

Free from artificial flavors, colors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Perfect for Kids

Soft, chewy, and individually wrapped—ideal for lunchboxes or on-the-go snacking.

Benefits:

Tasty & Nostalgic

Combines the beloved flavors of chocolate, graham, and marshmallow into a portable treat.

Safe for Schools

Nut-free and portion-controlled, making it suitable for allergy-aware environments.

Balanced Nutrition

A better-for-you snack with whole grains and fiber, without artificial ingredients.

Convenient Size

Perfectly portioned for small appetites or controlled snacking.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Chicory Root Extract, Milk Chocolate (sugar, cocoa butter, chocolate liquor, milk ingredients, soy lecithin, salt, vanilla extract), Brown Rice Flour, Sugar, Corn Syrup, White Chocolate Chunks (sugar, cocoa butter, milk ingredients, soy lecithin, vanilla extract), Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Enriched Wheat Flour, Maltodextrin, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor, Graham Flour, Invert Sugar, Salt, Molasses, Baking Soda, Calcium Carbonate, Honey, Baking Powder.
